note.after_visit_summary: You have a bacterial sinus infection causing facial pain, pressure, thick green nasal discharge, and fever. We have prescribed doxycycline 100 mg twice daily for 7 days to treat the infection. Take it with a full glass of water and stay upright for 30 minutes after each dose. Use sunscreen as this medication can increase sun sensitivity. Stop using Afrin nasal spray, as prolonged use can worsen congestion. Instead, use a saline rinse twice daily and fluticasone nasal spray (2 sprays in each nostril once daily) to reduce nasal swelling. You may continue ibuprofen 400 mg up to three times daily with food for pain or fever. A work note has been provided for Monday through today. Start to feel better in 3 days; if not, or if you develop swelling around the eyes, vision changes, stiff neck, or severe headache, call us or go to the emergency room. Return only if symptoms are not improving. We will call your cell at 555-0129 if needed regarding your prescription.
